name: SIASUN
name_zh: 沈阳新松机器人自动化股份有限公司
summary:
SIASUN develops industrial, mobile and specialized robots together with integrated manufacturing systems. Founded in Shenyang in 2000, the company supplies equipment and solutions for welding, assembly and logistics automation, with applications across automotive, electronics, semiconductors and other production sectors.

Its embodied-robotics portfolio extends this industrial base into mobile manipulation and humanoid systems. Publicly introduced platforms include wheeled and lifting humanoids in the Ruike family, the Songyi wheeled humanoid and the Songxing bipedal robot. SIASUN connects complete robot development with controls, integration and project engineering, using its manufacturing experience to pursue practical applications for intelligent machines.
